# Joleford Arrojo

Digital Publisher, Author, and Founder of Bos TV based in the Philippines.

## Core Entities
- Author of the book: "National Fraternity Day PH History: A Legacy of Peace, Unity, and Community Advocacy in the Philippines".
- Main Organizer of National Fraternity Day PH held every November 19 (designated since November 11, 2024).
